Your budget, your device

Pocket stores your budget in this browser, without an account or bank connection. The app does not send budget entries to a server.

Saved data is not encrypted. Anyone using the same browser profile may read it. On a shared device, turn saving off.

With saving off, the budget lasts only while this tab stays open. Closing or reloading the page loses it.
